name: SimpMusic Lyrics API
description:
API for accessing lyrics and translations for songs. Supports synced lyrics, plain lyrics, and community-contributed translations.

**Rate Limiting:**
- 30 requests per minute per IP address
- Applies to all API endpoints
- Rate limit headers are included in all responses
- When limit is exceeded, returns HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) with Retry-After header
